text:
9. 1. 4. 

Sambahulāsuttaṃ. 

224. Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikakhū kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu. Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā te bhikkhū apassantī paridevamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:

Arati viya me'jja khāyati bahuke disvāna vivittena āsane, 

Te cittakathā bahussutā ko'me gotamasāvakā gatāti. 

Evaṃ vutte aññatarā devatā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:

Magadhaṃ gatā kosalaṃ gatā ekacciyā pana vajjibhūmiyā, 

Migā viya asaṅgacārino aniketā viharanti bhikkhavoti.
